answers.text: '6.31 is the 5.1-10% late zone' -- a late zone is not in my position system: extension above resistance is the signal there (C26, R10). My tests on the grid: W HH/HL, D above EMA9 and 9>21, H1 HH/HL above EMA9; structure_shift ABOVE_STRUCTURE holds. D HH but LL is noted; the exit is a close below max(fib_swing_low, base_low_20d) (C29).

'elder_5d [10, 10, 10, 10, 10]: a summer plateau' -- in my method that plateau IS the TIF proxy confirming: elder_pattern SUSTAINED (R14, declared proxy). Elder's colour and value rules are not my test. W 9>21 HH/HL and D 9>21 above EMA9 keep the break intact; being in front of value is no fault in the position system (R10).

'long-stack criterion c2 fails; past the weekly pivot' -- the trend template is not my test, and C1 names no 50/150/200 average for me. Position system: W and D HH/HL, D 2.9% above the last swing high, ABOVE_STRUCTURE; W 11.02% past the pivot is strength, not a flaw (C26). H1 13% of range is why I let a buy order over bar_high be taken first (C27).

'rs LAGGARD in my blind read; late zone' -- my strength test reads rs_rank_pct 94.87, rs_spy_20d 18.89, ret_63d 15.0 (R12): a leader on my measure. D 7.0% past the swing high is no fault in my position system (R10). D HH but LL is real; W HH/HL and H1 above EMA9 9>21 hold. Exit stays a close below max(fib_swing_low, base_low_20d).

'new high on day_vol 0.46 ... high not being bought' -- my method reads thin volume as a liquidity caution (C25, R11), stated, never a reject; fund flow is COM (cmf), not served, so I cannot confirm or deny buying. Grid: D HH/HL 2.3% above the swing high, H1 79% of range, 9>21 on all frames. The buy order over bar_high makes the market prove demand (C27).

'far past the pivot with no base' -- distance past the pivot is not a fault in my position system (R10). D swing LH/LL is the real point and I already carried it as my case against; H1 below EMA9 at 18% of range. W HH/HL 9>21 still holds, so the break stands; the market must take the buy order over bar_high first.

'H1 closing at 1% of the day's range' -- a weak close is information my method acts on through price: no entry until a buy order over bar_high is taken (C27). The template's c2 is not my test (C1). W and D HH/HL, D 2.4% under the swing high, 9>21 on D and W: the structure claim stands.

'No break yet is my pre-pivot wait, not a fault' -- agreed on my own method: no break means no signal YET, and a set-up stays live until price takes the level (C5, C27). W and D HH/HL, D 3.2% under the last swing high. I move to a WAIT on close_above:pivot_high; impulse is not their test but TIF is mine.

'No break yet is the setup I wait on' -- on my method too: RANGE is no signal yet, not a flaw, and the order stays armed until price takes the level (C5, C27). W, D and H1 HH/HL, D 1.0% under the last swing high. I move to a WAIT on close_above:pivot_high.
